scientific_integrity: A finite exhaustive cubical computation establishes the complete rational automorphism character. The integral first-homology theorem is explicitly borrowed from Ko–Park, and general stable discretization from earlier graph-configuration literature. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to three unordered points on the cube graph. Does not classify the integral group-action lattice or give a family theorem. Bibliographic search does not exclude unindexed equivalent work.
title: The full octahedral second-homology character of three unordered cube particles
